summary: CS-ENT-CI-GATE-UNBLOCKERS-001 removes the current tenancy catalog/data-class blockers that were preventing honest broad CI evidence for the enterprise microservices worktree. It adds missing catalog rows for tenancy workspace crates and annotates tenancy lifecycle, cell assignment, isolation policy, DSR cascade, sub-scope registry, and lifecycle-lock kernel fields. Data-class validation now passes workspace-wide. Catalog validation advances past those tenancy rows and now blocks on the next unrelated pre-existing missing catalog record, oya-payments-adapter-adyen. No runtime tenancy behavior, Enterprise Suite cloud readiness, statutory filing, disbursement rail, or SLO evidence is claimed.
